title: Bar Adda, son of R' Yehudah’s brother
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bikkurim, chapter 1, halakhah 5; R' Zeira said [a teaching] in his name.[^1]

notes.text: Heading Yehudah and body Zeira have abbreviated titles, retained as R'. The heading retains Bar Adda and son of Yehudah’s brother; no additional father is inferred. Zeira reports in his name; the bracketed teaching is implicit. Chapter1, halakhah5 remains literal, and a Jerusalem Talmud identification is an unverified suggestion.
